findings.message: [BR-KSA-19]-Each Document level charge (BG-21) shall have a code for the reason for document level charge (BT-105).
[BR-KSA-60]-Cryptographic stamp (KSA-15) must exist in simplified tax invoices and associated credit notes and debit notes (KSA-2, position 1 and 2 = 02).
[BR-KSA-F-06-C32] - Field character limits for Buyer name field (BT-44) have not been met. The maximum limit is 1000 characters.
[BR-KSA-98] - The simplified invoice should be submitted within 24 hours of issuing the invoice.
[BR-KSA-69]-A VAT breakdown (BG-23) with VAT Category code (BT-118) 'Zero rated' shall have a VAT exception reason code (BT-121).
[BR-KSA-27]-The document must contain a QR code (KSA-14), and this code must be base64Binary.
Invalid QR code format, Please follow the ZATCA QR code specifications
